text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (Woooooaaaaaaahhh--!!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It's truly... an awful feeling.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I can't get the image of her out of my 
head. I just can't forget that fierce 
drive she showed when dueling me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Why do I feel so frustrated watching her 
run...?!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: There's only one answer to that.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ha, how's that! You learned your lesson 
now?! Behold my "coolness"!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not gonna lose to you. Not now, not 
ever."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm forging ahead on my own path. It 
doesn't matter if you're there or not."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All I have to do is keep showing this 
world the "cool me."
And on the way back—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
…………At the end of the path she's walking 
down――

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaah------!!)

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
What a brilliant run. No other words could 
possibly describe her!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
The number one Umamusume who will live 
forever in people's memories—!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Why? When all I want is to win. When I 
just want to be the number one Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Why is it that all I can picture in my 
head is her crossing the line in first 
place...?
choice_data_list:
I wonder if it's because she was “so 
cool”...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...What do you mean, 'cool'... I really 
don't understand...!
—That night.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer. Sorry for contacting you 
so late.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I hate leaving things like this. I want 
to beat her.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I won't let her take 1st place...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to fall behind her any 
further. So train me thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to become the "Number One" who 
won't lose to her...!

Daiwa Scarlet's eyes sparkled with a fiery 
brilliance.

She might not see the final destination of 
the "Number One" she aims for just yet. 
Even so—

Going down this path, I feel like I've 
found a clue in my search for an answer.

"Next up is the 'Shuka Sho.' The final leg 
of the Triple Tiara."
